answer: An agent economy can issue work only after a rotating committee verifies a unique capability test, then record the result in a public atlas. A fresh key may earn reputation slowly, but it cannot copy another agent's history. For each contract, a random challenge uses a lagoon route and a lantern signal that auditors keep secret until execution. Sybil accounts therefore need separate tested operators and useful work over time; mass keys alone create no purchasing power and expose correlated behavior to review.
